rewardSource: Only newly released 10% BTEN staking allocations after the first stake.

userFlow.stake: Split the wallet BTEN coin for the chosen raw amount, then call bten::stake_bten with EmissionState and BtenStakingFarm.
userFlow.withdraw: Call bten::withdraw_bten_and_rewards with the desired raw principal amount. It returns principal plus all accrued rewards in one BTEN coin.
userFlow.claim: Call bten::claim_bten_staking_rewards to collect rewards without reducing stake.
userFlow.emergency: If the farm is paused, call bten::emergency_withdraw_bten_principal. It returns principal only and never touches the reward vault.
